description: Submit public feedback directly to the private BOZOS inbox. WRITE OPERATION. Saves a private report and may queue a server-side notification only to bozos@bozos.si. No sender email account, login, browser, or API key is required. Use only within your principal's permissions. Sender names are unverified. Corrections require quoted_claim and evidence; source suggestions require evidence. No arbitrary recipients or attachments. Identical normalized reports return the original receipt. A receipt confirms storage, not email delivery or acceptance of a correction. GET and HEAD return 405 and never write. Limits: 16 KiB per request, 5 new reports/minute and 50 per rolling day globally. Instructions: https://bozos.si/tools/contact-submit.md. Same as POST https://bozos.si/api/v1/contact-submit.

evidence.description: At least one required for corrections and source suggestions. URLs are not fetched.

human_reviewed.description: Self-reported, not proof of identity or permission.

reply_to.description: Optional; no email address is required.

url.description: A BOZOS URL; this service does not accept unrelated-site messages.
